scope: All 80 business/return/architectural packets on 57 First Avenue / St. Marks faces, 51 buildings; protected Seventh retained.
sourcePixels: Not distributed or used as game textures. Source locators and transcribed observations are durable.
notes: Inspected all 93 frontal and 186 oblique crops in the complete candidate. Wide storefronts use overlapping crops; a contact-sheet seam is not duplicated model text.

Final seven-face repairs were separately captured and all 30 front/left/right crops inspected: Organic ledge no longer masks bottles; 75 canopy number follows the curved roof; Books has left entry, yellow/red right-side sign and crowded right window; SOCKS has rose fascia; Crif has separate word/star layout; both Bar Al Pastor faces have distinct outlined/filled lower paint panels.
Canvas winding and two-sided cloth, chair/table spacing, missing glyph fallback, retired duplicate signage and individual entrance/sign silhouettes were repaired before the complete-candidate set.
The final full candidate and seven-face repair captures have different PCK identities. The later geometry edits target those seven faces; the full set is not relabeled as one final-package capture.

Game views establish authored composition and rendering, not a calibrated camera/photo fit. Procedural material grain/weave, selected licensed fonts, tiny posters, product inventory, painted tags and interior depth remain approximations.
The April 2026/September 2024 reference dates do not establish October 2026 occupancy. Blank/unreadable signs and occluded detail remain explicit unknowns.

approachReview.breakdown: 18 stopped traversal-end captures in three weather modes, three mid-street player views, eleven perspective views.
approachReview.findings: Shop-specific awnings/signs/furniture remain visible in street context; no new obstruction diagnosed. Broad views do not resolve tiny lettering or certify roof/full-elevation photographic accuracy.
approachReview.captureMethod: Measured normal-key traversal first, then reset velocity at the measured endpoint for the capture. Review pose commands can display the existing transient reset toast; it is not the pictured location label.
